# cargo-lambda, for building the AWS Lambda binary in CI (Step 21), with the
# Zig toolchain it uses to cross-compile. Installed with
# `pip install --require-hashes`, so pip refuses any file whose SHA-256
# doesn't match. Hashes are PyPI's published ones for the Linux x86_64
# wheels. Dependabot (pip) proposes updates with new hashes.

    --hash=sha256:db2c0b1d53d7ed0055198fd045f641addc91b180b20d794fcf78cc9a9efacb38
ziglang==0.17.1 \
    --hash=sha256:ea6cc5d87b033cf0aedfbc8f9549a908cae6c50ac31f1698188fa48a74524b54
